title: Lambda Calculus AST Node Types
description: Build the three frozen dataclasses Var, Lam, and App that represent every lambda calculus term.

steps.description: Import dataclass and define Var as an immutable node storing a variable name and returning that name from __str__.
Define Lam for lambda abstractions with a parameter name and body node, formatted as (λname. body).
Define App for function application (func arg) along with short helper functions var, lam, and app.

steps.question: How will true_ = lam('t', lam('f', var('t'))) format when converted to a string?
steps.answer: Each Lam wraps its string in parentheses, so nested abstractions print as (λt. (λf. t)).

steps.description: Construct the Church encodings for identity, true_, and false_ and print their string representations.
Inspect the constructed AST objects for identity, true_, and false_ in the environment as they are printed.
